address: Zamek Topacz Resort & Art Spa, ul. Templariszy 1, Ślęza, 55-040, Poland
bio: The surroundings are an event in themselves at this restaurant situated on the estate of the same name, which has a 14th-century castle at its heart and now hosts bedrooms, a spa and even a motor museum across its various buildings and parkland. Dining takes place across several castle rooms and focuses on carefully executed dishes with heart and soul, such as comforting homemade blood pudding or generous duck breast with a rich, full-flavoured sauce.
